# Brand Marketian

> Brand Marketian is a marketing and growth agency for Indian brands, running social media, Meta and Google ads, SEO content, WhatsApp/CRM follow-up and influencer marketing as accountable, month-to-month retainers — clients own their ad accounts and assets, with no lock-in.

Brand Marketian works with D2C, retail, and service brands across India, building tracked, revenue-linked marketing systems rather than one-off campaigns. Engagements start within 10 working days, each service can be taken standalone, and reporting is tied to a jointly-defined qualified lead, not raw form fills.

## Services

- [All services](https://brandmarketian.com/services.html): Social media, Meta & Google ads, SEO content, WhatsApp/CRM funnels, and more — ten services, one accountable team.
- [Influencer & creator marketing](https://brandmarketian.com/influencer-marketing.html): Nano to celebrity creators across Instagram and YouTube, matched by audience fit and measured with UTMs and promo codes.
- [Industries served](https://brandmarketian.com/industries.html): Sector-specific approaches for the brands Brand Marketian works with.
- [Pricing](https://brandmarketian.com/pricing.html): Retainer structure and what is included at each tier.
